options.reason: The table is an acoustic-call corpus built to identify anurans, and Family, Genus and Species are nested taxonomic outcomes recorded together for the same row, so they are joint multilabel targets rather than leakage. RecordID is a recording key with 60 values over 7195 rows, so it groups segments that must stay in one partition and is not a per-row identifier. MFCCs are the only features; there is no chronology, no survival outcome and no derived target component.
options.title: multilabel
